hero.description: I build complete digital systems from the initial idea to a fully working product. Modern frontends, reliable backends, and carefully designed architectures — all in one place.

about.title: Turning ideas into powerful systems
about.description: For me, development is not just about writing code. It is about solving problems and creating systems that provide long-term value.
about.paragraph1: I have been developing software since 2017. What started as a hobby has grown into a passion for creating my own systems and solving complex technical challenges. I work across the entire development process — from frontend interfaces and backend architecture to databases and deployment.
about.paragraph2: I enjoy building projects where complex problems require clean and reliable solutions. I focus on well-structured code, performance, and creating systems that are not only functional today but remain easy to maintain and expand in the future.

flutryApi.title: Flutry REST API
flutryApi.description: Flutry is a custom backend system built entirely from scratch. The goal of this project was to create a stable, secure, and easily extendable architecture using modern TypeScript technologies. The system includes a structured API design, efficient data handling, authentication, and scalable solutions designed for real production environments.

portfolioSite.title: dev.otamoon.hu - Portfolio
portfolioSite.description: My personal portfolio website, built entirely with my own development solutions. It uses modern React Router V7 for optimized navigation, Tailwind CSS for a responsive design system, and a custom email service for contact forms. This project represents my full development skill set and commitment to writing high-quality software.
